vectors.name: BP worst-of-two: systolic red, diastolic green -> overall red
BP worst-of-two: diastolic critical, systolic green -> overall critical
Exercise 30min total is yellow (lower yellow edge)
Radiation at 80% of daily budget is green
Radiation at 90% of daily budget is yellow
Radiation at 100% of daily budget is yellow (upper yellow edge)
Radiation at 110% of daily budget is red
CMB-CHEST-01: severe chest pain -> critical emergency
CMB-CO2-01: headache+dizziness with SpO2 yellow -> red, possible CO2 (also triggers CMB-HYPOX-01: same symptoms legitimately satisfy both rules' trigger lists when SpO2 < 95)
CMB-INF-01: fever + fever_chills -> red, possible infection
CMB-VIS-01: vision change today only -> yellow
CMB-VIS-01: vision change persists 2 days -> red
CMB-DEHY-01: low hydration + fatigue -> flag yellow, but water_ml red drives overall red
CMB-SAM-01: nausea+dizziness in first 3 mission days -> yellow
CMB-SAM-01 does NOT fire after mission day 3
CMB-MENT-01: low mood + low_mood symptom -> red
CMB-SAFETY-01: self-harm flag -> critical emergency, always wins
CMB-BACK-01: back pain (moderate+) for 3 consecutive days -> yellow
CMB-BACK-01 does NOT fire without 2 prior consecutive days
CMB-HYPOX-01: SpO2 85 + shortness of breath -> critical
CMB-DCS-01: EVA today + joint pain -> red
CMB-DCS-01: EVA today + shortness of breath -> critical
CMB-DCS-01 does NOT fire without a recent EVA
CMB-IMM-01 does NOT fire when fever is present; CMB-INF-01 applies instead
TRD-SLP-01: sleep < 6h for 3 days in a row -> yellow
TRD-SLP-02: sleep < 6h for 5+ of last 7 days -> red (also triggers TRD-SLP-01)
TRD-HR-01: HR 15+ above 14-day baseline for 3 days -> yellow
TRD-EXR-01: under 30min exercise for 3 days -> trend yellow, today's own band is red
TRD-WGT-01: weight loss > 3% in 14 days -> yellow
TRD-RAD-01: cumulative radiation projected over mission budget -> yellow
TRD-MISS-01: 2-day gap since last log -> yellow reminder
TRD-MISS-01: 5-day gap since last log -> red, surgeon-view alert
TRD-TEAM-01: team_relations <= 2 for 3 consecutive days -> trend yellow, today's own band is red
CMB-SAM-01: nausea+dizziness on day 1 after a gravity change (late mission) -> yellow
CMB-SAM-01: nausea+dizziness on day 3 after a gravity change -> yellow
CMB-SAM-01 does NOT fire on day 4 after a gravity change
CMB-SAM-01 does NOT fire late in a mission with no gravity change (rover)
